[PATH:theoretical] Analysis of the Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) evolution across layers during extended training in low-data regimes — The NTK framework predicts how layers converge or diverge in function space; theoretical results on kernel alignment and lazy vs. rich learning regimes can indicate whether early and late layers are expected to diverge significantly under data scarcity.

[PATH:literature] Literature review of existing studies on layer-wise learning dynamics in supervised low-data settings (e.g., works on 'deep double descent', 'epoch-wise training dynamics in overparameterized models') — Surveys prior empirical and theoretical findings to assess whether the hypothesized divergence has been observed or contradicted, providing a basis for Bayesian updating of confidence.
